en.quote: If we assay to commune with thee, wilt thou be grieved? but who can withhold himself from speaking?
en.riddle: wilt thou be grieved? but who can withhold himself from speaking?
en.speaker: Eliphaz

he.quote: הֲנִסָּה דָבָר אֵלֶיךָ תִּלְאֶה וַעְצֹר בְּמִלִּין מִי יוּכָֽל
he.speaker: אליפת

en.2: If we assay to commune with thee, wilt thou be grieved? but who can withhold himself from speaking?

he.2: הֲנִסָּה דָבָר אֵלֶיךָ תִּלְאֶה וַעְצֹר בְּמִלִּין מִי יוּכָֽל׃

en.quote: Doth not their excellency which is in them go away? they die, even without wisdom.
en.riddle: Doth not their excellency which is in them go away?
en.speaker: Eliphaz

he.quote: הֲלֹא־נִסַּע יִתְרָם בָּם יָמוּתוּ וְלֹא בְחָכְמָֽה
he.speaker: אליפת

en.21: Doth not their excellency which is in them go away? they die, even without wisdom.
